sources.supports: OpenAI's GPT-5 model documentation lists cached input at $0.125 per million tokens, alongside the unchanged input and output prices.
The documented default GPT-5 snapshot is dated August 7, 2025, consistent with cached input being part of GPT-5's pricing from its initial dated snapshot.

notes: Classified as models_dev_fix: OpenAI's GPT-5 documentation lists cached input at $0.125/M with input/output at $1.25/$10, so the earlier models.dev record omitted an existing price. The Internet Archive had snapshots bracketing the update (2025-08-07T17:38:34Z and 2025-08-07T20:07:20Z), but extraction returned HTTP 429 even after the required wait; therefore no archive bracket or more precise historical effective time is asserted.
